provider.name: KvRedisExecutor (Redis-protocol store: Valkey/Redis over RESP, Upstash over REST)

metadata.note: The wire the EphemeralStatePort binding sends through KvRedisExecutor.execute, shown in the REST shape (a JSON command array) that the RESP and in-memory executors satisfy with the same commands. Pinned on purpose: the script body and its SHA-1 are part of the contract, because a store caches scripts by SHA and an edited script is a new script every server must load. Interactions run in order against a store whose script cache is empty: the first EVALSHA must answer NOSCRIPT as a returned error reply (never a throw), which is what makes the EVAL fallback reachable.

interactions.description: EVALSHA of a script the store has not cached answers NOSCRIPT as an error reply

body.message: NOSCRIPT No matching script. Please use EVAL.

interactions.description: EVAL of putIfAbsent creates the key and returns its first version

body:
if redis.call('EXISTS', KEYS[1]) == 1 then return false end
redis.call('HSET', KEYS[1], 'v', ARGV[1], 'i', ARGV[3], 'r', 1)
redis.call('PEXPIRE', KEYS[1], ARGV[2])
return ARGV[3] .. ':1'

interactions.description: EVALSHA of the now-cached putIfAbsent on a live key returns nil: a lost race, not an error
HMGET of a live key returns value, incarnation, and revision
HMGET of an absent key returns three nils
PEXPIRE of an absent key returns 0
